change: sleeves P1, R1, T1, T2, FC, MM, OIL scaled x0.5 on days when ES's previous daily close is below its 200-day moving average (K3, which is long or short, unchanged); applied to the daily sleeve P&L (positions and turnover scale with it)
judge: daily-flat equity-index book: 2023-26 >= 1.164 + 0.05 and 2018-22 not lower than 0.785
